mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, exceeding a 2% month-over-month decline, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input disruptions and rising costs.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances where the INDPRO trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, increasing by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises by > 5 points during the signal period, indicating that the labor market weakening is not impacting consumer spending attitudes.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth accelerates by > 2% YoY during the signal period, indicating that the restrictive monetary policy is not slowing the economy as expected.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5%, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer sentiment (UMich survey) rises by > 5 points during the signal period, indicating that the consumer sector is not as weak as the housing and unemployment data suggest.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing PMI falls below 45 and the industrial production index (INDPRO) declines month-over-month, it signals a manufacturing recession that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both the ISM_MFG and INDPRO trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the 10-year Treasury yield (DGS10) rises by more than 50 basis points in a month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a rapid rise in borrowing costs that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: DGS10 rises > 50bps in 1 month and FEDFUNDS > 3%
failure_condition: Corporate bond spreads (BofA ML US Corporate Index) narrow by > 20bps during the signal period, indicating that the rise in borrowing costs is not impacting corporate financing conditions as expected.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals a consumer spending recession that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Retail sales (Advance Retail Sales) rise by > 1% MoM during the signal period, indicating that the consumer spending recession signal from RSAFS is not accurate.
